apps.description: Contract redline copilot — clause-level suggestions against playbook positions, deviation scoring, fallback language.
Regulatory change radar — monitors regulators and maps new rules to internal policies and owners.
DPIA generator — data protection impact assessments auto-drafted from system inventories (GDPR/LGPD).
Litigation hold manager — custodian notices, acknowledgment tracking, preservation scope audit trail.
Patent prior-art scout — semantic search over patents and papers, claim chart drafts.
Whistleblower case triage — anonymous intake structuring, severity scoring, routing to counsel.
Policy attestation tracker — assigns policies, chases sign-offs, reports compliance coverage.
